q: How long does a typical project take?
a: A marketing website takes 4–6 weeks. Web apps and mobile apps usually take 8–14 weeks depending on scope. You get a dated plan before we start.
Each service has a base price, adjusted for scope and timeline. The pricing configurator uses the same logic we use for proposals, so the estimate is a reliable starting point.

q: Do you work with clients outside India?
a: Yes. Around half our clients are in the US, UK, Europe and Southeast Asia. We bill in USD and overlap at least four hours with your working day.

q: Who owns the code and designs?
a: You do. Full ownership of code, design files and accounts transfers to you on final payment.
Every build includes 30 days of support. After that you can move to a Grow plan or a flexible maintenance retainer.

q: Can you work with our existing team or stack?
a: Yes. We regularly plug into in-house teams, follow your code conventions and work inside your repos and tools.
